# aphes.ist lab kit 1.0.0, vendored

These files are a verbatim copy of the aphes.ist lab kit, the owner's design system for research
viewers. Do not edit them here: change the kit at its source and copy it again.

- Repository: `aphesist/aphesis` (https://github.com/aphesist/aphesis)
- Branch: `design-system`
- Commit: `d4087db` ("Add the lab kit: the system as one stylesheet and an optional script for research viewers")
- Path: `system/lab-kit/v1/` (`lab.css`, `lab.js`, `fonts/`), generated by `tools/lab-kit/build.py`
- Version: 1.0.0 (the head of `lab.css`, and `Lab.version` in `lab.js`)
- Online copy of the same version: https://aphes.ist/lab-kit/v1/ (the page never loads it: it links
  these files relatively, so it makes no requests outside its own origin)

## Font licences

- **Special Elite** (`fonts/SpecialElite-latin.woff2`, `fonts/SpecialElite-latin-ext.woff2`):
  Apache License 2.0, the full text in `fonts/SpecialElite-LICENSE.txt`.
- **Aphesis Script** (`fonts/AphesisScript-VF.woff2`): the owner's own typeface, from
  `aphesist/aphesis` (its `font` branch; copied into the kit by the kit's build). It is used here
  because contraprova is one of the owner's projects; the kit ships no separate licence file for it,
  so its terms are the owner's (see that repository).
